## Andy active-workstream checkpoint gate
When .ai/andy/current.json has an active, paused, or blocked workstream, read .claude/skills/andy/SKILL.md before finishing any turn with any state or workspace change.
Save silently before risky or long actions, after every state or workspace change, before returning control with unsaved work, and after at most three exchanges. The three-exchange save captures a compact conversation delta. Use fresh updated_at for guarded writes. Never print automatic-save details; display state only for explicit Andy status or Andy save.
Main thread only: dispatched subagents never read Andy or run this gate; they return results to Ori.
<!-- END MANAGED: andy/autosave -->

## Dream Team token governance (main thread)
- Yuli and Ori run as separate logical stages in THIS thread (mission and resource decision first, then orchestration decision). Record which stage decided. Never spawn `yuli` or `ori` as subagents.
- Default 1 agent at a time; at most 2 concurrently (hard maximum 4 only with a recorded justification). Two concurrent agents only when their scopes are disjoint and at most one of them writes. Parallel writers stay off until worktree isolation exists. Maximum spawn depth 1: dispatched agents never spawn further agents.
- Before any spawn answer: Is another agent actually required? Can the current bounded worker finish this? Is this work independent? Will this duplicate context? Is a specialist required? Is the requested model and reasoning justified? What is the stop condition? Otherwise: DO NOT SPAWN without a strong justification.
- Every agent gets a bounded contract and a scoped context packet (Codex: `fork_turns: "none"`), never the full history, HANDOFF or Andy state.
- Cheapest capable model and reasoning. High reasoning only for: security-sensitive work, difficult architecture, difficult root-cause analysis, important final validation.
- Attempt 3 must REPLAN (narrower context, different specialist, higher reasoning, model escalation, architecture review). Valdi: deterministic checks first; 1 validation + 1 revalidation per repair cycle.
- Andy autosave is main-thread only; dispatched agents never read `.ai/andy` or the Andy skill.
- Policy: Dream Team `dream-team/policies/governance.json` -> `resource_governance`.
<!-- END MANAGED: dream-team/token-governance -->
